description: This source file defines a sealed partial class GatewayInboundConnection within the Orleans.Runtime.Messaging namespace. It manages inbound gateway connections, handling message reception, rerouting, overload detection, and connection lifecycle management for Orleans silos. The class interacts with message centers, overload detectors, and gateway components to facilitate message routing, processing, and error handling in a distributed Orleans system.

classes.name: GatewayInboundConnection
classes.description: Represents an inbound connection at the gateway, responsible for handling message reception, rerouting, overload detection, and connection lifecycle within Orleans silo infrastructure.

methods.name: GatewayInboundConnection
methods.description: Constructor initializing the gateway inbound connection with dependencies such as message center, overload detector, and silo details.

methods.name: OnReceivedMessage
methods.description: Processes an incoming message, handling expiration, overload, rerouting, or direct sending based on message state and overload conditions.

methods.name: RunInternal
methods.description: Asynchronously runs the connection's internal processing, establishing the connection, performing handshake, and registering connection events.

methods.name: FailMessage
methods.description: Handles message failure scenarios, sending rejection or dropping the message based on message direction.

methods.name: PrepareMessageForSend
methods.description: Prepares an outgoing message for sending, ensuring it has not expired and setting the sending silo address.

methods.name: RetryMessage
methods.description: Retries sending a message if retry count allows; otherwise, fails the message.

methods.name: OnSendMessageFailure
methods.description: Handles failure during message sending, invoking FailMessage.

methods.name: LogRejectingRequestDueToOverloading
methods.description: Logs the event when a request is rejected due to overload.

methods.name: LogSiloRejectingMessage
methods.description: Logs when a silo rejects a message indicating overload or policy.

methods.name: LogSiloDroppingMessage
methods.description: Logs when a message is dropped by a silo.
